name: – Daniel Freund – § 20, point vi – Am 47
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (vi) ensure that all Commissioners and senior officials exercise their functions in full compliance with Union rules on integrity, conflicts of interest and sound administration and to recall that the former Commissioner that attacked the leading free speech platform X and its owner Elon Musk is a former chief executive officer of a French technology firm and France's leading telecom operator;
